propositions: A hard clarity floor must contain exactly two rules: (1) nonempty parsed AC checkbox items and (2) unresolved sentinel assignments in active execution sections with structural exclusions, after removing five candidates that either lack historical counterexamples or conflate clarity with schema validation.

Exact duplicate AC items must be reclassified from hard floor to advisory-only because ticket 8d27-7ee1-f137-4b88 demonstrates that redundant but unambiguous global gates pass both plan-review and completion review.

Bare unresolved sentinels must be narrowed to only structural assignment forms (TBD/TODO/FIXME/??? as value markers in Approach/Scope/Testing/Acceptance Criteria, outside code fences), excluding removal assertions like 'NO stale TODO', with zero counterexamples to the narrowed predicate.

File-impact path/reason validation must be removed from clarity scoring and retained only as write-schema invariant enforcement at mutation boundaries, as structural integrity is not a clarity signal.

[rebar:id] prerequisite citation checking must be removed from raw clarity scoring and retained only in grounding exception paths when an absent file/symbol claims prerequisite-created credit, as tickets 6673-7636-a116-4f90 and 94f9-a9a0-7475-4e75 show legitimate transitive provenance and downstream references are valid and common.
